action.description: pass = proceed; block = fail-closed; review = route to HITL.

verdict.description: fail = a dirty scrub was ENFORCED (block/hitl); warn = 0 PII found but the scan can't CERTIFY clean (sampled or non-NER backend, #889); else pass.

verified.description: #889 — clean is a GUARANTEE: 0 PII AND a full scan (not sampled) AND a certifying NER backend. A consumer/pipeline gates on THIS, not `clean`.

blocking.title: Blocking
